purpose: Summarize which quantities are preserved and which are transformed when the Core Expression projects into a domain-specific completed RT.

variant_table.witness_reading: The projected RT may be counted as complete only after closure verification.
The projected RT remains the same governed RT identity after explicit projection typing and closure verification.
A completed RT is preserved only after the projection is typed and closed in the receiving domain.
Residue records projection history and may differ by receiving domain.
Orientation changes when the Core Expression is rebound into the receiving witness context.
State is domain-specific and may vary across projections.
Scale-expression follows the receiving domain rather than the source label.
Metric equivalence is not assumed across projections.
Slot role depends on explicit rebinding and does not carry automatic symmetry.
